name: JV_JOINT_VENTURES_B
description: This table contains the joint venture definitions.

columns.name: JOINT_VENTURE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: JOINT_VENTURE_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: The unique code representing the short name of the joint venture.

columns.name: JOINT_VENTURE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status code of the joint venture.  It is based on ORA_JV_JOINT_VENTURE_STATUS lookup codes such as ORA_JV_ACTIVE, ORA_JV_INITIATED, or other user defined values.

columns.name: RESPONSIBLE_USER_ID
columns.description: The person responsible for the joint venture.

columns.name: APPROVED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the joint venture has been approved by the stakeholders.

columns.name: APPROVED_DATE
columns.description: The date the joint venture was approved.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Unique ID of the business unit associated with the joint venture.

columns.name: COA_INSTANCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Links the chart of accounts structure instance number to the joint venture to identify which account segment contains the cost center.  This value is validated against the FND_KF_STR_INSTANCES_B table.

columns.name: AR_INVOICE_MINIMUM_AMOUNT
columns.description: The minimum amount required to create an accounts receivable invoice.

columns.name: AP_INVOICE_MINIMUM_AMOUNT
columns.description: The minimum amount required to create a payables invoice.

columns.name: AP_LIABILITY_ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: The account combination identifier for the default liability account used when creating a payables invoice.

columns.name: SEGMENT1_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether segment 1 is allowed to have distributable values associated with it.

columns.description: Name of the default ownership percentage associated with the joint venture that will be used to identify the stakeholders and their share of the transaction.

columns.name: INCEPTION_DATE
columns.description: The date that the joint venture became active and eligible for processing.

columns.name: BILL_WHEN_PAID_FLAG
columns.description: Determines whether joint venture distributions are created for paid expenses or costs.

columns.name: RECEIVABLE_ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: Account combination identifier for the default receivable account used when creating a receivables invoice.

columns.name: CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the classification of a joint venture as operated or non-operated.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTABLE_ACCT_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the account set used by the joint venture to identify distributable accounts.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_ONLY_ACCT_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the distribution only account set used by the joint venture to identify accounts whose transactions will be distributed and not invoiced.

columns.name: JIB_TEMPLATE_NAME
columns.description: The name of the Joint Interest Billing report template associated with the joint venture.

columns.name: JIB_REPORT_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: The format of the Joint Interest Billing report output associated with the joint venture. It's based on ORA_JV_JIB_OUTPUT_FORMAT lookup codes such as ORA_JV_HTML, ORA_JV_PDF, ORA_JV_RTF, and so on.

columns.name: EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: The email address of the managing partner.

columns.name: EXCLUDE_JV_TRANSACTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Determines whether the Identify Joint Venture Transactions process will include invoices and journal entries created by joint venture processes.

columns.name: PROJECT_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the project set associated with the joint venture.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the legal entity associated with the joint venture.

columns.name: BILLABLE_ASSET_ACCT_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the account set used by the joint venture to identify billable asset accounts.
